description: This file defines the SettingsWindowOpener class which manages opening settings or preferences windows in a macOS application. It includes protocol definitions for menu actions related to settings windows and provides fallback mechanisms to mimic built-in menu actions.

classes.name: SettingsWindowOpener
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for opening the settings window, either through a registered action or by mimicking the system menu item actions.

methods.name: register(openSettings:)
methods.description: Registers a custom action for opening the settings window.

methods.name: open()
methods.description: Activates the app and attempts to open the settings or preferences window, using a registered action or fallback via menu action selectors.
